source: One immutable typed owner retained until output transfer or bounded cancellation completes
ownership: Framework value; no application, window, document-store, or OS dependency

limits.retainedCapacity: Requested payload capacity is checked against the remaining operation limit before reservation; actual reported capacity is checked before admitting the empty allocation. Allocator-private memory, fixed cursor metadata, and source ownership are excluded.

grant.maximumItems: Caller permit for structural work; each step consumes at most one
grant.maximumBytes: Caller permit for copied UTF-8 bytes; each step consumes at most this value and 256
grant.zero: Report blocked without changing phase, checkpoint, pending UTF-8 bytes, or retained ownership

completion: Preserve variant, object entry order, duplicate keys, integer precision, and UTF-8 bytes
cancellation: Retire at most one partial structural item per granted close step; return the exact source in the terminal close receipt after completion or cancellation
lifecycle: Cursor and step receipts are must-use; explicit terminal-empty close is enforced without recursively draining in Drop
sourceAccess: At most maximumDepth indexed array/object lookups; no scanning or recursive cloning
